press_references.value: ADIB and ADHA Launch Instant Digital Pre-Approval for Home Financing

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Abu Dhabi Housing Authority have formalised a partnership that embeds ADIB’s automated credit engine into ADHA’s housing programme to provide UAE nationals with instant digital pre-approval on layered Shari’a-compliant home financing.

press_references.value: ADIB launches mobile salary payment service for UAE employers

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank worked with Al Etihad Payments and the UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation to develop a WPS-compliant digital salary payment service integrated with national regulatory systems.

press_references.value: ADIB and Emirates NBD in deal to refinance Pullman London

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Emirates NBD entered their second 50/50 club deal partnership to jointly provide a £121 million refinancing facility for Union Property’s Pullman London St Pancras asset.

press_references.value: ADIB strengthens partnership with Jubail Investment company to deliver landmark development in Abu Dhabi

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank signed a new Memorandum of Understanding with Jubail Investment Company to deepen their long‑standing partnership on the Jubail Island project, adding expanded Sharia-compliant financing, property management via MPM Properties, and joint marketing for JIC customers.

press_references.value: ADIB launches new cashback programme for all cardholders in partnership with Mimojo

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank formed a new partnership with Mimojo to power and operate a cashback programme for all ADIB cardholders.

press_references.value: ADIB supports youth career readiness in collaboration with ADEK through a job placement programme for students across Abu Dhabi

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank partnered with the Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge to run a job placement and financial literacy programme for Emirati students aged 15 to 18 in Abu Dhabi.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Majid Al Futtaim launch the first Sharia-compliant SHARE Covered Cards

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Majid Al Futtaim formed a strategic partnership to launch Sharia-compliant ADIB SHARE Visa covered cards linked to the SHARE rewards ecosystem.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Visa Team Up to Launch Cross-border Money Transfer Service

partnership_announcements.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Visa have announced a partnership to launch a cross-border money transfer service, enhancing their collaboration in digital payments.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone to Streamline Business Banking Access

press_references.value: ADIB and DAMAC ease the path to homeownership with new comprehensive finance solution

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Damac Properties launched a joint home financing solution offering flexible structures, fee waivers, short-term cost support, and complimentary property takaful to make homeownership more affordable in the UAE.

press_references.value: ADIB launches “Sanadna”, a dedicated initiative to support the nation’s frontline heroes

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank launched the Sanadna initiative, a new package of financial benefits and fee waivers tailored to UAE frontline personnel and SMEs, including deferred instalments, grace periods, fee waivers and prize-linked savings incentives.

press_references.value: ADIB enhances customer banking experience with fully digital onboarding for instant home finance approval and cards journeys

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank introduced a fully digital onboarding experience that enables instant in-principle home finance approvals and immediate virtual card issuance for customers via a straight-through digital process.

press_references.value: ADIB becomes first Islamic bank to implement open finance with the support of the CBUAE’s open finance initiative AlTareq

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank launched its Open Finance capability under the UAE central bank’s AlTareq initiative, enabling customers to access integrated digital financial services via secure APIs.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Majid Al Futtaim launch the first Sharia-compliant SHARE Covered Cards

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, in partnership with Majid Al Futtaim, launched the ADIB SHARE Visa Infinite and Visa Platinum Sharia-compliant covered cards that reward customers with SHARE points across over 5,000 Majid Al Futtaim destinations.

press_references.value: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Visa Team Up to Launch Cross-border Money Transfer Service

product_launches.description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and Visa have jointly launched a new cross-border money transfer service, expanding their offerings in international payments.

product_launches.description: A personal finance management tool that allows users to track income and expenses, categorize spending, and visualize cash flow for better financial planning.

product_launches.description: ADIB's first comprehensive report outlining its journey towards reducing carbon emissions and setting sector-specific decarbonisation targets for 2030.

about_short_description.short_description: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank is an Islamic bank based in Abu Dhabi city, in the United Arab Emirates.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant deposit and transaction accounts for individuals, including current, savings, salary, student, children’s, investment and short-term accounts.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for personal needs, including general personal finance, debt settlement, salary advances and goods Murabaha.

product.name: Home Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant property financing for purchasing, constructing or refinancing residential homes and related housing needs.

product.name: Covered Cards
product.description: A range of Sharia-compliant Visa and Mastercard covered cards for payments, travel benefits, cashback, rewards, instalment purchases and business spending.

identifier.value: Auto, Electric Vehicle, Education, Travel and Boat Finance

product.name: Auto, Electric Vehicle, Education, Travel and Boat Finance
product.description: Asset and purpose-specific Sharia-compliant financing for vehicles, electric vehicles, education, travel and boats.

product.name: Takaful Solutions
product.description: Sharia-compliant protection plans covering motor vehicles, cards, personal finance, school fees, health-related needs, personal accidents and households.
